DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 訓練の案内で、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the training information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持ち物に飲み物とあります。受付で渡す物でしょうか。それとも、私が途中で飲むための物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 訓練持参飲物が受付提出か自飲用か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The list of things to bring says drinks. Are those something to hand in at reception, or are they for me to drink during the session?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the drink you bring to training is to be handed in at reception or to drink yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 参加される方が、ご自身で飲むためにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Participants should bring drinks for their own use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもも一緒なので、私と子どもの二本を用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 親子二人用にボトル二本を準備すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. My child will be with me, so I will prepare two bottles, one for me and one for my child.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will prepare two bottles for yourself and your child. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お二人でご参加ですね。申込みも二名になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: There will be two of you attending. Your registration is also for two people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。子どものボトルは小さいので、かばんの中で私の物と分けて入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二名申込と小さい子用ボトルを分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. My child's bottle is small, so I will pack it separately from mine inside the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that two people are registered and say that you will pack the child's small bottle separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訓練中のお荷物は、会場の荷物置場を使える案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: According to the information, you may use the venue's luggage area for your belongings during training.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 飲み物をかばんへ入れたまま置く前に、休む時間には取り出せるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物置場のボトルを休憩時に取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before I leave the bag there with the drinks inside, I would like to ask whether I can take them out during breaks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can retrieve the bottles from the luggage area during breaks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 休憩の際は荷物置場からお取りいただけます。ボトルへお名前も付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may retrieve them from the luggage area during breaks. Please put your names on the bottles too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前を付けます。親子二本を持ち、受付に渡さず、休憩で自分たちが飲むよう準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記名二本を自分たち用に持参すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will label them with our names. I will bring two bottles for myself and my child, and prepare them for us to drink during breaks rather than hand them in at reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will bring two bottles labeled with your names for your own use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、当日お待ちしております。お子様とご準備ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to seeing you on the day. Please get ready together with your child. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お食事の準備で、お手伝いすることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything I can help you with as you get ready for your meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: スプーンが左にあります。今は右手で使いたいので、右側へ置いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左スプーンを使用右手側へ移動依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The spoon is on the left. I would like to use my right hand now, so could you put it on the right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the spoon on the left to be moved to the right, where your hand will use it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの位置で、手が届きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you reach it in this position?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 届きます。コップも左の奥にあるので、スプーンの横へ寄せてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 届く位置を確認し奥左コップも右へ依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The cup is also at the back on the left, so I would like you to move it next to the spoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you can reach it, and ask for the cup at the back left to be moved to the right too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: コップを右側へ移しました。トレーの端からは離して置きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have moved the cup to the right. I will keep it away from the edge of the tray.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この位置なら、腕を遠くまで伸ばさずに持てます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 右位置で腕を伸ばさず持てると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. In this position, I can pick it up without stretching my arm far.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you can pick it up on the right without stretching your arm out. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに、必要な物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything else you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙のナプキンを一枚お願いします。先に膝へ置いてから食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 膝に置く紙ナプキン一枚を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: One paper napkin, please. I would like to put it on my lap before I eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for one paper napkin to put on your lap. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらをお使いください。食器の位置は、今のままでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use this. Are you happy with the utensils and cup where they are now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、スプーンとコップはこのままで大丈夫です。ナプキンも受け取ったので、ゆっくり食べ始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食器位置とナプキン受領を確認して食事を始める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, the spoon and cup are fine as they are. I have received the napkin too, so I will start eating slowly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the placement of the utensils and cup and receipt of the napkin, and begin your meal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お食事をどうぞ。お困りでしたらお呼びください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your meal. Call me if you need anything. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 留守番電話について、ご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to consult us about a voicemail, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族だと言う声が入っていました。でも、誰か分からないので、この音声を聞いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族を名乗る声の主が不明で留守電確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a message from someone claiming to be family. But I do not know who it is, so could you listen to this recording?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know who left the voicemail claiming to be family, and ask for it to be checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保存してある音声を確認します。いつ届きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the saved recording. When did it arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝の九時です。別の番号へ電話してほしいと言っていますが、まだ折り返していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 九時受信と別番号折返要求と未応答を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: At nine this morning. They asked me to call another number, but I have not called back yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that it arrived at nine, requested a call back to another number, and that you have not responded. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご家族の方には、確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you been able to check with your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 兄には連絡できました。兄は電話していないそうです。ほかの家族には、まだ聞けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 兄は否定し他家族は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was able to contact my older brother. He says he did not call. I have not been able to ask my other family members yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your older brother denied calling and the other family members have not been checked with yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、その状況も合わせて伺います。音声を再生できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell us about those circumstances too. Can you play the recording?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 再生します。最初に家族だと言い、最後に番号を読み上げています。ここまでで全部です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保存音声を再生して名乗りと番号読上げを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will play it. They say they are family at the beginning and read out a number at the end. That is the entire message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Play the saved recording and point out the claim to be family and the number being read out. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その番号を、ご自身でメモした物もございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you also have a note you made yourself of that number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: このメモです。聞き間違いがあるかもしれないので、音声と一緒に見てください。受信時刻も書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己番号メモの誤聴可能性と受信時刻を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is my note. I may have misheard, so please look at it along with the recording. I have written down the time it arrived too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Point out that your own note of the number may contain a listening error and includes the time of receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、音声とメモで確認します。ご相談ありがとうございます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the recording and your note, then. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 海外へのお手紙ですね。宛先を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a letter to go overseas. Let me see the destination address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所と名前は英字で書きましたが、国名は日本語にしました。国名も英字にした方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 英字宛名住所に日本語国名を書き国名表記を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the address and name in Roman letters, but the country name in Japanese. Should I write the country name in Roman letters too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you wrote the name and address in Roman letters and the country in Japanese, and ask how to write the country name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この宛先は、国名も英字で分かるようにご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this destination, please write the country name clearly in Roman letters too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 書き方は、友達から来た住所のメッセージにあります。最後の行の国名を、そのまま写したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の住所メッセージ最終国名行を写したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The spelling is in the message with the address my friend sent me. I would like to copy the country name on the last line exactly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to copy the last line with the country name from your friend’s address message. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛先の一番下に、ほかの行と分けてお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write it at the very bottom of the destination address, on a separate line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書きました。町や通りの名前ではなく、最後の国名の行だけを直しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名末尾へ国名行だけを書き直したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have written it. I corrected only the last line with the country name, not the town or street names.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you rewrote only the country-name line at the bottom of the destination address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 差出人の住所とお名前も、お書きになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you also written the sender’s address and name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 裏に私の日本の住所と名前を書きました。そこには日本から送ることも分かるように書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 裏の日本の差出住所氏名と送信国記入を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote my address in Japan and my name on the back. I will also write it so that it is clear the letter is being sent from Japan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out your Japanese return address and name on the back and the country from which you are sending it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先全体を、友人のメッセージと見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please compare the whole destination address with your friend’s message.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前、住所、国名を確認できました。国名の字も読めます。この封筒の重さと送り方を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先全体を照合し重量送り方の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the name, address and country name. The country name is legible too. Please check the weight of this envelope and how to send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the entire destination address and ask for the weight and sending method to be checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お預かりして確認します。ご準備ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take it and check, then. Thank you for getting everything ready. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 金額の欄で、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the amount field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一万円を出したいです。マスが並んでいますが、左端から一を書けばよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一万円の金額欄の書出し位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to withdraw ten thousand yen. There is a row of boxes; should I write the one starting at the far left?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to start writing ten thousand yen in the amount field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 右端が一円の桁です。右から順に、金額が入る位置を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The box on the far right is the ones place for yen. Let us check where the amount goes, starting from the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右にゼロを四つ、その左に一ですね。左端から書くと大きい金額になる所でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右端基準でゼロ四つ左に一と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So four zeros on the right and a one to their left. If I had started from the far left, it would have become a large amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that, starting from the far right, there are four zeros with a one to their left. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一万円の記入は、その五つのマスです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Those five boxes are where you write ten thousand yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一とゼロ四つを書きました。空いた左のマスへ、続けてゼロを書く必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 五桁記入後左空欄にもゼロが必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have written a one and four zeros. Do I need to keep writing zeros in the empty boxes on the left?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After filling in five digits, ask whether zeros are also needed in the empty boxes on the left. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この用紙の左の空欄は、そのままで結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may leave the empty boxes on the left of this form as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、このままにします。金額は一万円で、通帳の口座からお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空欄を保持し指定通帳から一万円希望を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will leave them as they are, then. The amount is ten thousand yen, from the account in this passbook, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will leave the boxes blank and want ten thousand yen from the specified passbook account. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの欄と通帳も、一緒に確認します。お名前は書かれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check the other fields and your passbook together too. Have you written your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前も書きました。口座番号は通帳から写しました。金額欄と合わせて、用紙と通帳をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名口座記入と通帳用紙の提出を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written my name too. I copied the account number from my passbook. I will give you the form and passbook so you can check them along with the amount field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have filled in your name and account number and are handing in the passbook and form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、記入内容を確認します。ご準備ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the information you filled in, then. Thank you for getting everything ready. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのほうじ茶も、お試しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to try this roasted green tea too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。麦茶を飲んだカップをまだ持っています。これへ入れてもらえばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 使用済麦茶カップでほうじ茶試飲できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I still have the cup I drank barley tea from. Should I have you pour it into this?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can taste the roasted green tea using the cup you used for barley tea. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 次の飲み物は、新しい紙カップでお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We serve the next drink in a new paper cup.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。最初の空のカップは、この台へ置いてよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最初の空カップを置く場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. May I put the first empty cup on this counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check where to put the first empty cup. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 空のカップは、横の回収箱へお願いします。こちらに少量のほうじ茶を入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please put empty cups in the collection box at the side. I have poured a small amount of roasted green tea into this one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最初のカップを回収箱へ入れ、新しい方を受け取ります。少しだけ味を見たいので、この量で大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一杯目廃棄と新少量カップ受領を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put the first cup in the collection box and take the new one. I only want a little taste, so this amount is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you are disposing of the first cup and receiving the new cup with a small amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お飲みになったら、同じ回収箱へ入れられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you have drunk it, you may put it in the same collection box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 飲めました。麦茶とは違う香りですね。買う物はまだ家族と決めていないので、今日は試飲だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 香りの違いと家族未決定で試飲のみを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have finished it. It has a different aroma from barley tea. My family and I have not decided what to buy yet, so I am only tasting today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention the different aroma and say you are only tasting because your family has not decided what to buy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 結構です。商品はこちらの棚にもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is fine. The products are on this shelf too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 売り場が分かりました。二つ目の空カップも箱へ入れ、買い物の続きをします。試させてくださってありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二杯目カップを回収箱へ入れ買物を続けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Now I know where they are sold. I will put the second empty cup in the box too and continue shopping. Thank you for letting me try them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the second cup in the collection box and continue shopping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。それでは、お買い物をお楽しみください。またお声がけくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You are welcome. Enjoy your shopping, then. Please feel free to ask us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記念碑の文字をご覧になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the lettering on the monument?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二文字が読めません。年の前にある言葉は、何と読みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 碑の年の前の二文字の読みを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot read these two characters. How do you read the word before the year?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to read the two characters before the year on the monument. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 「開園」で、「かいえん」と読みます。公園が開かれたことを表す言葉です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The word is pronounced “kaien.” It means the opening of a park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: かいえんですね。ノートに読み方を書きます。今日来た日付と、碑に書かれた年は別に残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: かいえんの読みと碑年と訪問日を別記録にすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kaien, then. I will write the pronunciation in my notebook. I want to record the date of today’s visit separately from the year written on the monument.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the pronunciation “kaien,” the year on the monument and the date of your visit separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 碑の年は、こちらの下の行です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The year on the monument is on this line below.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見えました。その年を「開園」と一緒に書き、今日の日付は写真のページへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 碑年を開園と記し当日日付を写真欄に入れると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can see it now. I will write that year together with “kaien,” and put today’s date on the photo page.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will write the monument’s year with “kaien” and put today’s date in the photo section. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お写真もお撮りになったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You took a photo too, then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。正面から一枚撮りました。文字は小さいので、家で見た時に読めるよう、今の読みを添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真文字が小さいため読みを今書く目的を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I took one from the front. The lettering is small, so I will add the pronunciation now so that I can read it when I look at it at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you are writing the pronunciation down now because the lettering in the photo is small. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに、読みにくい言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are there any other words that are hard to read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は開園だけです。読み方と年を記録できました。あとは自分の写真を見ながら、家でページを整えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認語は開園のみで家で写真頁を整えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only “kaien” today. I have recorded its pronunciation and the year. I will finish arranging the page at home while looking at my own photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that “kaien” is the only word you needed checked and that you will finish the photo page at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、よい記録になりますように。公園をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22221-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope it makes a lovely record. Enjoy the park. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札の前でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble at the ticket gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 閉じた傘の先が扉に引っかかりました。無理に引かずに止まっています。こちらの通路から出られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 傘が扉に引っかかり停止した事情を話し係員通路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The tip of my folded umbrella got caught in the gate. I have stopped without pulling it forcefully. Can I get out through this passage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your umbrella got caught in the gate and you stopped, and ask about the staff passage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 係員の通路へご案内します。まず傘をこちらへゆっくり戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will show you to the staff passage. First, slowly pull the umbrella back this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 戻せました。傘のひもも留めます。切符は手に持っていますので、見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 傘を戻しひもを留め切符確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have pulled it back. I will fasten the umbrella strap too. I have my ticket in my hand, so could you check it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have pulled the umbrella back and will fasten its strap, and ask for your ticket to be checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切符を確認します。お連れの方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check your ticket. Is anyone with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人います。もう改札の外へ出ました。私も外へ出てから合流したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者は改札外にいると伝え合流を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: One person. They have already gone outside the ticket gates. I would like to meet them after I get outside too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your companion is outside the ticket gates and that you would like to meet up. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの扉を開けます。傘を体の近くに持ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will open this door. Please keep the umbrella close to your body as you go through.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。傘を横へ突き出さずに通ります。外のどこで待ち合わせれば、次の人の邪魔になりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内通路を通り出口で邪魔にならない合流場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will go through without sticking my umbrella out to the side. Where outside can we meet without getting in the way of the next person?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Go through the passage as directed and ask for a meeting place outside the exit where you will not obstruct anyone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口右側の待合席をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use the waiting seats on the right of the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 右の待合席ですね。友人へそこに来るよう伝えます。切符の確認と通路の案内、助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 右待合席を確認し同行者へ伝えて謝意を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: The waiting seats on the right, then. I will tell my friend to come there. Thank you for checking my ticket and showing me the passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the waiting seats on the right, tell your companion, and express your thanks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、待合席へどうぞ。修善寺駅をご利用いただきありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the waiting seats, then. Thank you for using Shuzenji Station. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 集会室では、どのような活動をされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What sort of activity will you be doing in the meeting room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で、言葉を使わない劇の動きを練習します。座席の数より、机のない床の広さを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人の無言劇練習で座席数より空床寸法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two of us will practice movements for a play without words. Rather than the number of seats, I would like to know how much floor space there is without tables.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that two people will practice mime and ask for the dimensions of the clear floor space rather than the seating capacity. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの小室は、机を除いた部分が縦四メートル、横三メートルです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this small room, the area excluding the tables is four meters long and three meters wide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四メートルと三メートルですね。二人が腕を広げてすれ違う動きがあるので、実際の空間も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 四×三メートルを確認し腕を広げる動きのため見学を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Four meters by three meters, then. We have a movement where we pass each other with our arms outstretched, so I would like to see the actual space too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the four-by-three-meter dimensions and ask to view the room because your movements involve outstretched arms. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本日は係と一緒に小室をご覧いただけます。大きい道具は使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can view the small room with a staff member today. Will you use any large props?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 道具は持ちません。床に寝る動きもないです。靴を履いたまま動ける場所か教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 道具と寝る動きがないと話し靴条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will not bring props. We will not do any movements lying on the floor either. Please tell me whether we can move around with our shoes on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will use no props and do no lying-down movements, and ask about the footwear requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらでは室内用の靴へ履き替えます。入口に履き替える場所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here, you change into indoor shoes. There is a place to change shoes at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では二人分の室内用の靴を準備します。見学では机を自分たちで動かす必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 室内靴二人分を準備し見学時の机移動担当を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then we will prepare indoor shoes for both of us. Will we need to move the tables ourselves during the viewing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will prepare indoor shoes for two people, and ask who will move the tables for the viewing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見学用の空間は係が用意します。移動する机はこちらで扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Staff will prepare the space for viewing. We will handle any tables that need moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は床の広さを見て、二人の動きが収まるか相談します。見学をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 床見学で二人の動きが収まるか相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Today we will look at the floor space and discuss whether there is room for both of our movements. We would like to view it, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want to view the floor space and discuss whether both people’s movements will fit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、小室へご案内します。練習の準備にお役立てください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will show you to the small room, then. I hope it helps you prepare for practice. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 測定について、測定担当へ伝えることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you need to tell the person in charge of taking measurements?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっき体重計に乗った時、肩にかばんを掛けたままでした。厚いコートも着ていたので、量り直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: かばんと厚いコートを含めて量ったため再測定を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I got on the scale a little while ago, I still had my bag over my shoulder. I was wearing a thick coat too, so could I be weighed again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to be weighed again because the measurement included your bag and thick coat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 測定担当にその状況を伝えます。今はかばんをこちらの椅子へ置いてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will explain the situation to the person taking the measurements. For now, please put your bag on this chair and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 椅子へ置きました。最初の数字は画面に出ましたが、かばんを含む測定だったと伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: かばんを置き最初の数値に荷物が含まれたと伝達を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have put it on the chair. The first number appeared on the screen, but please tell them that the measurement included my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have put down your bag and ask them to explain that the first reading included your belongings. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。測定担当が来ましたので、何を持っていたかもう一度お話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. The person taking the measurements is here now, so please explain again what you had with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このかばんとコートです。ポケットに水のボトルも入っています。外してから測るよう案内していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: かばんコートとポケット内ボトルを示し外す案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: This bag and coat. There is also a water bottle in my pocket. I would like you to guide me to remove them before being weighed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out your bag, coat and the bottle in your pocket, and ask for instructions on removing them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 測定の担当と一緒に持ち物を置きましょう。コートはこちらのかごへ入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us put your belongings down together with the person taking the measurements. Please put your coat in this basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入れました。かばんとボトルも置けました。呼ばれたら、担当の案内で体重計へ乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当案内で荷物を置き測定へ進むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have put it in. I have put down my bag and bottle too. When I am called, I will get on the scale following the staff member’s instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have put your belongings down as instructed and will proceed to be weighed under the staff member’s guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 測定が終わりました。記録の確認は測定担当にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The measurement is finished. Please ask the person who took it about checking the record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。最初は荷物を持っていたことと、今は外して量ったことを測定担当に確認します。荷物を回収して待合へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二回の測定条件を測定担当と確認し荷物回収後待合へ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will confirm with the person who weighed me that I had belongings with me the first time, and that I have now been weighed without them. I will collect my belongings and return to the waiting area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the conditions of both weighings with the person who took them, collect your belongings and return to the waiting area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お忘れ物をご確認ください。次の案内まで待合でお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22222-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check that you have not forgotten anything, then. Wait in the waiting area until the next instructions. Take care of yourself.
